findings.label: Auth gate redirect missing
findings.description: After sign-in, users return to home, not to the original action. Capture intended action context and resume after auth succeeds (likely in AuthContext or useRouter hook).

findings.label: Compare list desyncs on rapid edits
findings.description: If user removes an item while the 4-item limit UI is visible, the button state may not update immediately. Add a debounce or optimistic update to prevent UI confusion.

findings.label: Vertical form gating incomplete
findings.description: Rental, appointment, hotel inquiry, and job apply forms are specified in requirements but not yet wired to listing detail pages. These should appear as call-to-action buttons on relevant listing types.

findings.label: Test coverage sparse
findings.description: No test files visible for auth gating, contact buttons, or form submission flows. Add unit tests for useGate hook, AuthGateSheet modal, and vertical form submission to reduce regression risk.
